protocol: Full rows; training-only preprocessing/screening/REML; validation selects one of two arms; test evaluation follows persisted choice
pilot_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python benchmarks/benchmark_real_interactions.py --output .benchmark-artifacts/real-interactions/pilot-20260913 --fit-timeout 75 --total-fit-budget 600
suite_exit_reason: Three REML failures; credit interactions refused because the additive screen fit failed.

discovery_limits.candidate_set_sizes_compared: Additive versus one capped candidate set, not adaptive count selection
discovery_limits.missed_candidate_types: Mixed hour/weather and other categorical interactions; no cyclic interaction representation; weak-margin and nonlinear pure interactions can also be missed
discovery_limits.timing_limit: Candidate generation, marginal shortlisting and product scoring share one clock; training prediction and full additive screening fit are charged separately

verification.focused_tests_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run pytest benchmarks/test_real_interactions.py -q

mutation.change: Admit nonconverged arms into validation selection

verification.row_budget_demonstration: Pre-parse admission test failed before the row guard, then passed.

after_run_loader_audit.scope: Post-run observation, not a loader hash captured by each worker. Dataset agent confirms no loader edits during fits. Post-corpus-scan changes were formatting and a categorical-declaration guard, with unchanged parsing. Per-arm byte/schema-entry/split/preprocessor hashes are direct run evidence.
